FFmpeg/ffprobe sources, one entry per target platform-arch key.

macOS (darwin-*) uses osxexperts.net pinned release builds with immutable sha256 hashes recorded at pinning time. NOTE: osxexperts.net has twice updated binaries without updating its published checksum page; the hashes below are the ones we verified against the actual server payloads (ffmpeg/ffprobe 9.0 arm64, built 2026-07-07; 8.0 intel).

Windows and Linux use BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds master builds tracked through the stable `latest` release tag (rolling = true). BtbN only keeps a short window of dated daily autobuilds, and the `latest` tag is the permanent URL for the newest package that never expires. Because the artifact is moving, prepare.mjs cannot pin a single sha256; instead it downloads the publisher's `checksums.sha256` sidecar from the same release (cryptographic integrity against the published digest) and, when run natively, asserts the extracted binaries are a static GPL build (ffmpeg/ffprobe -version and -buildconf). NEVER reintroduce pinned BtbN autobuild URLs or hashes - both expire together.
